Title: Track rework labor separately
BusinessProblem: Rework hours are recorded the same way as normal production hours, so Finance cannot see what rework costs. Overages appear only as route quantity variance.
DesiredOutcome: Monthly rework labor hours and cost by item and operation, included in the production variance report.

Title: Add approval step for vendor bank account changes
BusinessProblem: Vendor bank details can be changed by AP without a second review. This is a payment fraud risk and was raised in the last audit.
DesiredOutcome: Any change to vendor bank details requires Controller approval before payments can be made to the new account.
ApprovalComments:
Grace Lin: Approved. Priority control from audit finding.
Sandra Whitfield: Approved. Deploy after October close.

Title: Add scrap reason codes for polish operation
BusinessProblem: Scrap at the polish operation is recorded without a reason, so Quality cannot see which failure modes drive scrap.
DesiredOutcome: Operators select a scrap reason when reporting scrap at operation 30. Reasons reportable monthly.
ApprovalComments:
Dana Reyes: Approved.
Grace Lin: Approved. No impact to standard cost.

Title: Notify Maintenance immediately when a machine goes down
BusinessProblem: Maintenance learns about downtime by phone or radio, sometimes hours later. Response time is not measured.
DesiredOutcome: Maintenance receives a Teams notification within one minute of an operator logging downtime.

Title: Grant planned order firming to Production Planner
BusinessProblem: Rachel Kim cannot firm planned purchase orders and has to ask her manager each time, delaying purchases.
DesiredOutcome: Production Planner role can firm planned purchase orders up to the existing approval limits.
ApprovalComments:
Ian Fletcher: Approved.
Grace Lin: Approved. Confirmed no SoD conflict with vendor maintenance.

Title: Put failed inspection lots on quality hold automatically
BusinessProblem: Lots that fail inspection can still be picked and shipped until Quality manually blocks them.
DesiredOutcome: Lots that fail inspection are blocked from picking until Quality releases them.

Title: SharePoint site for Quality procedures
BusinessProblem: Controlled procedures live in a shared drive with no version control or approval history, which is an ISO audit risk.
DesiredOutcome: A document library with versioning, approval and retention for Quality procedures.

Title: Add customer PO number field to production orders
BusinessProblem: Supervisors cannot see which customer order a production order is for.
DesiredOutcome: Customer PO number visible on the production order screen.
ApprovalComments: Carla Mendes: Rejected. Customer PO is already on the sales order and visible through the pegging view. Business Systems to show supervisors how to find it.

Title: Change standard cost for fiber spools
BusinessProblem: Fiber spool purchase price rose 12% in Q3, so standard cost is understated and variances are large.
DesiredOutcome: Standard cost for fiber spools updated to current purchase price.
ApprovalComments:
Grace Lin: Approved.
Sandra Whitfield: Rejected. Standard costs change only in the annual cost roll in December. Include in that process.

Title: Email supplier automatically when a PO is approved
BusinessProblem: Buyers email purchase orders to suppliers manually after approval, and sometimes forget.
DesiredOutcome: Approved purchase orders are emailed to the supplier contact automatically.

Title: Update run time for operation 30 Polish
BusinessProblem: Route estimate for polish is 0.5 hours per unit, but actual time has averaged 0.65 hours for six months, creating false variances.
DesiredOutcome: Route run time for operation 30 matches observed actual time.
ApprovalComments:
Dana Reyes: Approved.
Grace Lin: Approved. Effective for November production; no restatement.

Title: Power BI production variance report
BusinessProblem: The monthly variance report is built by hand in Excel from an F&O export.
DesiredOutcome: An automated variance report refreshed daily.
ApprovalComments: Business Systems: Cancelled at requester's request. Revisit after rework labor tracking is live.

Title: Calibration work orders for laser test benches
BusinessProblem: Test bench calibration is tracked in a spreadsheet and has been missed twice this year.
DesiredOutcome: Calibration scheduled as recurring maintenance work orders with due-date alerts.

Title: Remove departed employee from AP approval workflow
BusinessProblem: A former AP lead is still listed as an approver in the vendor invoice workflow.
DesiredOutcome: Former employee removed from all F&O workflows and security roles.
ApprovalComments:
Grace Lin: Approved. Urgent.
Sandra Whitfield: Approved.

Title: Shift handover page for Plant 2 supervisors
BusinessProblem: Shift handover notes are on paper and get lost between shifts.
DesiredOutcome: A SharePoint page where supervisors post and read shift handover notes.

Title: Change cycle count tolerance for low-value items
BusinessProblem: Cycle counts on low-value items create many small adjustments that each need approval.
DesiredOutcome: Adjustments under $25 on low-value items post without approval.

Title: New work center for Plant 1 dicing saw
BusinessProblem: The new dicing saw has no work center, so its time is reported against the old saw and costed at the wrong rate.
DesiredOutcome: Dicing saw set up as its own work center with its own cost rate.
ApprovalComments:
Carla Mendes: Approved.
Grace Lin: Approved. Cost rate reviewed with Cost Accountant.

Title: Alert when the nightly MRP batch job fails
BusinessProblem: When master planning fails overnight, planners work from stale data until someone notices.
DesiredOutcome: Business Systems and Supply Chain are emailed when the master planning batch job fails.

Title: Add rework checkbox to job registration screen
BusinessProblem: Operators have no way to mark hours as rework when clocking in.
DesiredOutcome: A rework checkbox and reason on the shop floor terminal.
ApprovalComments: Dana Reyes: Rejected. Superseded by configuration approach in 'Track rework labor separately'. No customization needed.

Title: Quality access to Plant 2 Operations site
BusinessProblem: Quality engineers cannot see downtime records on the Plant 2 Operations site.
DesiredOutcome: Quality team has read access to downtime records.
